paragraphs: Hyman cites R' Elazar ben Antigonus: Shabbat 103b; Rabbi Chanina ben Antigonus: Shevi'it, chapter 6, mishnah 3.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The second patronymic is shortened to ב״א and expanded from the Antigonus heading.

The complete Davidson Shabbat 103b page, seventeen whole paragraphs, is a bounded nonmatch for the supplied Elazar ben Antigonus pointer. That first title therefore remains R' with Hyman’s attribution. The whole Torat Emet 357 Mishnah Sheviit 6:3 explicitly names Rabbi Chanina ben Antigonus, locally supporting the second full title and ב״א expansion. The current note remains verbatim, without proving one father or identifying the two pointers.
